lines: brings together limited-time driveaway offers, national promotions, special editions and dealer specials
Enjoy complimentary sunroof and premium paint on selected Alfa Romeo models across the range during the End of Year Sales Event. Offer ends 21 December 2026.
Get a $4,000 deposit contribution on selected Alfa Romeo models when financed through Alfa Romeo Financial Services, with a maximum 84-month term. Offer ends 21 December 2026.
Enjoy a $7,500 factory bonus on the Alfa Romeo Giulia Quadrifoglio, or save $15,000 on the Giulia Quadrifoglio Super Sport and Estrema models.

Alfa Romeo is celebrating its Italian heritage with limited edition Tributo Italiano versions of the Tonale, Stelvio and Giulia. These special models feature exclusive Italian flag-inspired colors, black roof accents, Brembo brakes and premium leather interiors with red stitching. Limited to just 60 units nationwide, they offer a mix of style, performance and exclusivity for Alfa enthusiasts.
